sql.query: SELECT c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseCategory,c.clauseHtml,c.sortOrder,c.isActive,c.modifiedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') modifiedBy FROM tbl_contract_clauses c LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=c.modifiedByUserId WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=c.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=c.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY c.isActive DESC,COALESCE(c.clauseCategory,''),c.sortOrder,c.clauseName
